itemDecisions.comment: Transferred financial asset shows the Control History table (AC-001). UI.

No confirmed transfer shows no table (AC-003). UI.
Multiple transfers ordered newest to oldest (AC-004). UI.
Table appears in the UI view (AC-005). UI. Authoritative coverage of AC-005 this release.
Table appears via eoRequestExport report API (AC-005). API. Contract UNVERIFIED; approving authorises capture + HUMAN_APPROVED conversion at Gate 2. Cannot assert AC-005 until then.

Table appears via eoGetDocumentActivityHistoryReport report API (AC-005). API. Contract UNVERIFIED; approving authorises capture + HUMAN_APPROVED conversion at Gate 2. Cannot assert AC-005 until then.
